title: Simulating Multi-Stakeholder Decision-Making with Generative Agents in Urban Planning
reasoning: The paper evaluates agent performance and collective reasoning using two distinct value frameworks: an 'altruism-driven' framework and an 'interest-driven' framework. By explicitly testing how agents navigate these moral and social values in a decision-making context, the study moves beyond a simple ethical disclaimer and makes the evaluation of moral reasoning a core component of its methodology.
